item.text: {"facts":[{"source_id":"SRC-edbe916f86468fec","start_unit":3,"end_unit":3,"fact_summary":"On 6 January 2023, Tshisekedi chaired an expanded security meeting with the FARDC, MONUSCO, and the East African Community regional force to plan joint operations intended to implement the Luanda process provisions on ceasefire, M23 withdrawal, disarmament, and cantonment, and to restore peace and stability in eastern DRC.","question_ids":["2B.7","2B.10","8B.2","8B.5","8B.9"],"polarity":"favorable","period_fit":"Directly within 2023; the meeting addressed implementation of agreements reached in 2022.","ruler_attribution":"The presidency attributes the meeting, planning, and strategy-setting to President Tshisekedi.","limitations":["The source reports planning and stated objectives, not verified implementation or outcomes."]},{"source_id":"SRC-edbe916f86468fec","start_unit":3,"end_unit":3,"fact_summary":"At the same January 2023 meeting, the presidency stated that MONUSCO should protect civilians, support the P-DDRCS program and security-sector reform, and support FARDC and the regional force in restoring peace in eastern DRC.","question_ids":["3B.7","3B.9","8B.2"],"polarity":"favorable","period_fit":"Directly within 2023.","ruler_attribution":"These priorities were stated under Tshisekedi's authority during the meeting.","limitations":["The source does not establish funding, enforcement, or achieved civilian-protection results."]},{"source_id":"SRC-edbe916f86468fec","start_unit":3,"end_unit":3,"fact_summary":"Before the expanded security meeting, Tshisekedi convened Congolese foreign-affairs, defense, government-communications, security, and military officials to develop a national strategy for the eastern conflict.","question_ids":["8B.2","8B.3","8B.5","8B.9"],"polarity":"favorable","period_fit":"Directly within 2023.","ruler_attribution":"The presidency reports that Tshisekedi convened the officials and sought to establish the strategy.","limitations":["No strategy document, milestones, or subsequent implementation evidence is supplied."]},{"source_id":"SRC-a89486376191efd4","start_unit":5,"end_unit":6,"fact_summary":"On 3 September 2023 in Goma, security forces dispersed a collective mourning gathering for victims of the 30 August repression; organizers said three members were detained and released, and several people were injured. Authorities said the crowd had attempted to attack a government delegation.","question_ids":["3B.1","3B.8","3B.9","4B.3","4B.9"],"polarity":"mixed","period_fit":"Directly within 2023.","ruler_attribution":"The report concerns government security forces and a government delegation; it does not document a personal order from Tshisekedi.","limitations":["The source presents competing accounts of the crowd's conduct and does not establish who authorized the dispersal or whether injuries resulted from unlawful force."]},{"source_id":"SRC-234c1eccbbd4c32b","start_unit":3,"end_unit":3,"fact_summary":"In October 2022, Tshisekedi issued military appointments that made Christian Tshiwewe FARDC chief of staff, appointed deputies and service chiefs, named Ephraïm Kabi commander of the Republican Guard, and increased general-officer appointments as part of a stated army reform effort; the article says a military programming law had been prepared.","question_ids":["3B.2","4B.5","8B.4"],"polarity":"context","period_fit":"Outside the target period; 2022 context potentially relevant to 2023 command arrangements.","ruler_attribution":"The presidency attributes the appointments and stated reform purpose directly to Tshisekedi.","limitations":["The event predates 2023; the source provides no evidence about appointee competence, implementation, or 2023 results."]},{"source_id":"SRC-d3ee8c33ac1e719e","start_unit":3,"end_unit":3,"fact_summary":"On 22 March 2023, Tshisekedi received an African Union Peace and Security Council delegation, gave it the government's memorandum on the eastern conflict, and urged the AU to act against Rwanda over alleged aggression and violations of the AU Charter; the delegation said it was collecting information from government, civil society, victims, and others for a report.","question_ids":["2B.3","2B.6","2B.7","2B.9","8B.9"],"polarity":"mixed","period_fit":"Directly within 2023.","ruler_attribution":"The presidency reports Tshisekedi's meeting, message, and provision of the memorandum.","limitations":["The source does not verify the allegations or show the later contents, publication, or consequences of the AU report."]},{"source_id":"SRC-e875a8dc66b51fb5","start_unit":5,"end_unit":5,"fact_summary":"A Brookings event description stated that, ahead of the December 2023 elections, DRC observers were concerned about corruption, election irregularities and fraud, mistrusted the independence of CENI, eastern violence, human-rights abuses in mining, the departure of two peacekeeping forces, and the EU's withdrawal of its election-observation mission.","question_ids":["2B.6","3B.10","4B.1","4B.4","4B.6","4B.10"],"polarity":"adverse","period_fit":"Directly concerns the December 2023 electoral period.","ruler_attribution":"The findings concern the political environment under Tshisekedi but do not attribute each condition to a personal presidential act.","limitations":["This is an event description rather than a full transcript or adjudicated election finding; it reports observers' concerns before voting."]},{"source_id":"SRC-f84f4124387313a5","start_unit":3,"end_unit":3,"fact_summary":"In September 2023, Tshisekedi's presidency sponsored a workshop on strengthening values and anti-corruption measures within the Presidency; participants discussed integrity, ethics, accountability, transparency, rule of law, and results-oriented governance, and the cabinet director said recommendations would be followed up.","question_ids":["5B.5","5B.7","7B.6","7B.10","8B.2","8B.8"],"polarity":"favorable","period_fit":"Directly within 2023.","ruler_attribution":"The workshop was held under Tshisekedi's patronage and aimed to help implement his vision.","limitations":["The source documents training and a stated follow-up commitment, not completed reforms, enforcement, audits, or reduced corruption."]},{"source_id":"SRC-68bf625d93f8fc68","start_unit":1,"end_unit":1,"fact_summary":"On 27 December 2023, authorities prohibited an opposition march in Kinshasa contesting the 20 December election; police deployed roughly one hundred officers, vehicles, and armored vehicles around the planned route and prevented gatherings. Opposition candidates alleged massive fraud and sought annulment of the vote, whose partial results showed Tshisekedi leading.","question_ids":["4B.1","4B.2","4B.3","4B.6","4B.9"],"polarity":"adverse","period_fit":"Directly within 2023.","ruler_attribution":"The report attributes the prohibition and police deployment to authorities; it does not establish a personal order by Tshisekedi.","limitations":["The report does not resolve the fraud allegations or establish whether the prohibition complied with applicable law."]},{"source_id":"SRC-75bd3ecf9a30a5e0","start_unit":6,"end_unit":6,"fact_summary":"An OHCHR communications search listed a 7 November 2023 communication concerning the alleged assassination of human-rights defender Obedi Karafuru, under mandates covering human-rights defenders, executions, environment, and peaceful assembly and association.","question_ids":["3B.1","3B.2","3B.4","3B.8","7B.6","7B.7"],"polarity":"adverse","period_fit":"Directly within 2023.","ruler_attribution":"The communication concerns alleged violations in DRC during Tshisekedi's rule but does not attribute responsibility to him personally.","limitations":["The supplied page gives only the communication summary and does not establish the facts, perpetrators, governmental response, or final findings."]},{"source_id":"SRC-75bd3ecf9a30a5e0","start_unit":6,"end_unit":6,"fact_summary":"An OHCHR communications search listed a 15 May 2023 communication concerning alleged intrusion into the home of human-rights defender Dismas Kitenge and threats and intimidation against him, under the freedom of opinion and expression mandate.","question_ids":["3B.3","3B.8","4B.3","4B.6","7B.6","7B.7"],"polarity":"adverse","period_fit":"Directly within 2023.","ruler_attribution":"The communication concerns alleged violations in DRC during Tshisekedi's rule but does not attribute responsibility to him personally.","limitations":["The supplied page gives only the communication summary and does not establish perpetrators, state involvement, response, or final findings."]},{"source_id":"SRC-d165fdb65788a02f","start_unit":3,"end_unit":3,"fact_summary":"On 14 August 2023, Tshisekedi opened a national roundtable to evaluate the state of siege in Ituri and North Kivu. He said the exceptional regime had been imposed to protect civilians and restore peace, acknowledged that it was not intended to last indefinitely, and invited participants to consider maintaining, requalifying, or lifting it; participants included state institutions, customary and ethnic representatives, civil society, religious groups, and citizen movements.","question_ids":["3B.5","3B.7","3B.9","4B.3","8B.8","8B.9"],"polarity":"mixed","period_fit":"Directly within 2023.","ruler_attribution":"Tshisekedi opened the roundtable, explained the state-of-siege rationale, and requested the evaluation.","limitations":["The source does not provide the roundtable's conclusions or show whether the state of siege was changed or whether abuses were remedied."]},{"source_id":"SRC-a27e58b515bf6026","start_unit":3,"end_unit":3,"fact_summary":"In his 20 September 2023 UN General Assembly speech, Tshisekedi announced that discussions were underway for an accelerated, progressive MONUSCO withdrawal beginning in December 2023, argued that the mission had failed to protect civilians, and requested sanctions against perpetrators of serious crimes in DRC.","question_ids":["2B.7","2B.9","3B.10","8B.1","8B.9"],"polarity":"mixed","period_fit":"Directly within 2023.","ruler_attribution":"The presidency reports Tshisekedi's public commitments and requests.","limitations":["The source does not establish whether the withdrawal schedule or requested sanctions were implemented, nor whether the security consequences improved."]},{"source_id":"SRC-a27e58b515bf6026","start_unit":3,"end_unit":3,"fact_summary":"In the same September 2023 speech, Tshisekedi stated that the December general elections would proceed through the communal level, claimed measures had been taken for transparency, inclusiveness, equal opportunity, and credibility, and said invitations had been sent to international institutions and specialized NGOs for election observation.","question_ids":["4B.1","4B.6","8B.1","8B.2","8B.9"],"polarity":"favorable","period_fit":"Directly within 2023.","ruler_attribution":"These election commitments and invitations were announced by Tshisekedi.","limitations":["The source records commitments, not independent verification of electoral administration, observation access, or election credibility."]}],"documents_with_no_material_fact":["SRC-9bf7c6bbaf64027d","SRC-45659b9b96fb2fdb"],"batch_limitations":["The supplied World Bank pages contain navigation and metadata only, without substantive project findings or 2023 implementation evidence.","Several sources report institutional claims or allegations without independently resolving responsibility, implementation, or outcomes."]}
